result.summary: Wrote lit.md for seed 808 / B group / round 2, answering analysis.md §5's Q1-Q4 (price-grid granularity measure day_distinct_ratio(Ret); the round's strongest "processing trick" — conditional bucket standardization + own-history/rolling-max; the non-monotonic/barbell size source cs_last_high05(LogFloatCap,LogFloatCap); and non-volatility intraday "shape" statistics for N idea 1). All 24 cited sources are pre-2023-08-08 (papers, working papers, or institutional research reports: Harris 1991, Lesmond-Ogden-Trzcinka 1999, Onnela-Töyli-Kaski 2009, O'Hara-Saar-Zhong 2019, Amihud 2002, Butt et al. 2022, Hung-Chen-Fang 2015, Gervais-Kaniel-Mingelgrin 2001, George-Hwang 2004, Asness-Porter-Stevens 2000, Bali-Engle-Murray 2016, Connolly-Stivers 2003, Asness-Frazzini-Israel-Moskowitz-Pedersen 2018, Van Dijk 2011, Shleifer 1986, Hou-van Dijk 2019, Hou-Xue-Zhang 2020, MSCI "Mid-Cap Effect" 2012, MSCI Barra CNE5 Descriptor Details 2013 (read directly as PDF — confirms China's standard non-linear-size construction: cube of standardized size orthogonalized to size, a concrete literature-backed alternative to the hard-cutoff screen used by source B), Gompers-Metrick 2001, Admati-Pfleiderer 1988, Gao-Han-Li-Zhou 2018, Heston-Korajczyk-Sadka 2010, Barclay-Warner 1993), each confirmed via WebSearch/WebFetch/direct PDF read and marked verified:true. Each finding is translated into a concrete, testable operator-language suggestion for the mining team. Sources with uncertain publication dates (e.g. a 2022/2023 AEA working paper on optimal nominal price) or unverifiable behind logins (a Springer "illiq_zero" paper) were explicitly excluded and listed as "searched but unusable" rather than fabricated, per the task's no-invention rule.
